title: Suikoden Anime's New Video Reveals Ending Song, October 3 TV Debut
content: The staff for Suikoden: The Anime , the adaptation of Konami 's Suikoden II game's story, streamed the third full promotional video for the anime on Friday. author: ANN

title: Dark Machine the Animation Series Reveals 3rd Promo Video, Ending Theme Song, Manga Adaptation
content: The staff for Dark Machine the Animation , the original anime for the Dark Machine game and anime project , began streaming on Friday the third promotional video, and it reveals and previews the ending theme song "Galaxy Mode" by Sandaime J SOUL BROTHERS . The song will launch with the band's new album on October 21.
author: ANN

title: Edia Re-Releases Falcom's Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes I & II Games
content: Edia announced on Wednesday that it will re-release Nihon Falcom's Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes and Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes II role-playing games. Edia did not announce a release date or platforms for the games.
author: ANN

title: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World Anime's Teaser Unveils Tomokazu Sugita in Cast, January Debut
content: Kadokawa presented a new teaser promotional video for the television anime of Yasukiyo Kotobuki 's The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World ( Arafō Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki ) light novel series on Friday.
author: ANN

title: AnimeJapan Opens Entry Submissions for 'New Creator Awards 2027' on October 1
content: AnimeJapan announced on Friday that it will begin accepting entries for "AnimeJapan New Creator Awards 2027" from October 1 until February 6, 2027. The competition, now in its second year, is aimed at nurturing and supporting the discovery of new anime creative talent.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Finale
content: The Summer 2026 anime season is almost over, and it was by far one of the best in recent years. Apart from the several exciting new anime hits, a lot of sequels made headlines with their intense arcs and plot development.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Drops Special Trailer Ahead of Finale – Watch
content: The anticipated Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and as the last quarter of the year, it’s going to be the biggest one so far. With the return of Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and several more sequels and new debuts, the season is packed with some of the most exciting shows in recent years.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Reveals Additional Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Oreco Tachibana 's Hotaru no Yomeiri ( Firefly Wedding ) web manga revealed additional staff, the opening theme, and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 9 at 11.30 p.m. on Fuji TV noitaminA.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime's Promo Video Reveals Iri's Opening Theme Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga announced on Friday that Iri will perform the opening theme song "Period," marking her first song for an anime. The staff began streaming a promotional video that previews Iri's song: The song will launch on November 18.
author: ANN

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Jujutsu Kaisen
content: Jujutsu Kaisen has become one of the most modern and popular shonen anime series of all time. It has set a caliber that few other anime can actually match, especially in the shonen genre, as it is almost a seinen anime due to its mature themes.
